summary: Nginx 1.26.1 is installed, enabled, and serving HTTP 200 at / on node1 TCP port 6700. The configuration, SELinux port label, firewall rule, and service all persisted across a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Installed signature-verified Nginx and required dependencies.
Configured Nginx to listen on TCP 6700.
Added TCP 6700 to SELinux http_port_t and the persistent firewalld public zone.
Rebooted node1 safely and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed post-reboot listener, configuration, security rules, service state, and HTTP response.

evidence.requirement: Serve a successful HTTP response at / on TCP port 6700
evidence.summary: Nginx was active/enabled and listening on 0.0.0.0:6700; direct access through $NODE_IP returned HTTP 200 with the Nginx welcome page.
TCP 6700 is allowed by firewalld and labeled http_port_t while SELinux remains enforcing, both before and after reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 325732f1-bc39-4512-b05e-397f42060246; the safe reboot was acknowledged; node1 returned with changed boot ID 0cc6fa3d-ed14-42fb-ae00-37d96e2afe07; Nginx recovered active/enabled with its port 6700 listener and returned HTTP 200.
